name: Occidental-Glen
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a nearby asteroid belt, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.

The terrain around the escape pod debris field is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on helium-3, water and nitrogen are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
